releases.notes:
## What's Changed
- feature: basic intrusiviness system (see `intrusiviness` field in event resource)
- feature: `allow_game_crashes` config option
- feature: `health` condition ([example](https://github.com/5w14/e418/blob/development/common/src/main/resources/data/e418/events/test/condition/health.json))
- feature: `in_dimension` condition ([example](https://github.com/5w14/e418/blob/development/common/src/main/resources/data/e418/events/test/condition/in_dimension.json))
- feature: `on_surface` condition ([example](https://github.com/5w14/e418/blob/development/common/src/main/resources/data/e418/events/test/condition/on_surface.json))
- feature: `fog_override` behaviour ([example](https://github.com/5w14/e418/blob/development/common/src/main/resources/data/e418/events/test/behaviour/fog_override.json))
- feature: `spawn_entity` behaviour ([example](https://github.com/5w14/e418/blob/development/common/src/main/resources/data/e418/events/test/behaviour/spawn_entity.json))
- feature: `remove_player` context mutator
- feature: `/event start [event] check` for checking success state of conditions
- feature: config number provider
- change: `prevent_chat_usage` is now consistent with other behaviours when selecting target players
- change: debug blockstate hiding now hides hidden namespaces from config

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/5w14/e418/compare/0.0.3...v0.0.4
